Name: Elle's Town Animals
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]

- 42 options for all butterflies
- 18 options for town birds in each season
- 20 options for theatre birds
- 2 options for seagulls
- 2 options for crows
- 2 options for owls
- 6 options for the Dark Shrine of Selfishness doves
- 4 options for the bird in the title screen
- 2 options for woodpeckers
- A replacement for the bird in the intro sequence (based on choice for town birds in spring)
- 10 options for pet parrots (ie the Night Market parrot and the parrot in Emily's 4 heart event)
- 6 options for squirrels
- 3 options for Alex's dog, Dusty
- 6 options for both town frogs
- 12 options for town rabbits in each season
- A replacement for the traveling merchant's pig
- A replacement for the desert trader's camel
- 2 options for the Trash Bear
- 6 recolor options for Hat Mouse
- A replacement for the secret woods bear

This mod also adds several of the new animals added in 1.5! They are listed in the spoiler marker below if you wish to remain surprised:
[spoiler]- 18 options for the new birds that appear after you get a perfect rating
- 42 options for island butterflies
- 3 options for Gourmand
- 3 options for the large turtles
- 10 options for the crab critter (does not affect the crab item you get from crab pots/mobs)
- 2 options for gem birds
- 2 options for the marsupial 
- A replacement for the gorilla
- 3 options for caldera monkeys
- 15 options for a new small bird
- 10 options for island parrots

Known creatures this mod [b]does not[/b] currently change:
- The blue trader bird[/spoiler]

Under the spoiler are preview images of replacements for 1.5 creatures:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.
[b][color=#e69138]5[/color][/b]. Open the config.json with a program like Notepad and use the images in the References folder to change each creature to the sprite you prefer. All creature replacements can be disabled with the value "False"
[b][color=#e69138]6[/color][/b]. Run the game using SMAPI to play with your new critters!

To uninstall, just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.

[color=#00ff00][b][u]Note about 1.5 spoilers[/u][/b]:[/color] For reference images, I separated new creatures from 1.5 into the last 3 images and named them as "mild spoilers". These creatures have no descriptions about what they are or where they appear, but they do show a sprite of the vanilla animals like the other reference images. They are the last 16 entries in the config if you wish to disable them by changing their values to "False".
